mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sn_line_attach(bill_no, seq, manual_value, material_code, k3_value, filled_by, filled_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{billNo}, #{seq}, #{value}, #{materialCode}, #{k3Value}, #{by}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE manual_value = VALUES(manual_value), material_code = VALUES(material_code), k3_value = VALUES(k3_value), filled_by = VALUES(filled_by), filled_at = VALUES(filled_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)

INSERT INTO sn_line_length(bill_no, seq, manual_value, material_code, filled_by, filled_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{billNo}, #{seq}, #{value}, #{materialCode}, #{by}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE manual_value = VALUES(manual_value), material_code = VALUES(material_code), filled_by = VALUES(filled_by), filled_at = VALUES(filled_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)

INSERT INTO sn_line_unit(bill_no, seq, manual_value, material_code, filled_by, filled_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{billNo}, #{seq}, #{value}, #{materialCode}, #{by}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE manual_value = VALUES(manual_value), material_code = VALUES(material_code), filled_by = VALUES(filled_by), filled_at = VALUES(filled_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.bill_no) FROM sn_prd_mo m

SELECT m.bill_no, MAX(m.customer_code) customer_code, MAX(m.po) po, MAX(m.pi) pi, MAX(m.org_code) org_code, MAX(m.org_name) org_name, MAX(m.modify_time) modify_time, SUM(FLOOR(m.qty)) total_qty, COUNT(*) line_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(m.dept_name, '') ORDER BY m.dept_name SEPARATOR '、') dept_name, SUM(COALESCE(c.gen_count, 0)) gen_sum, SUM(GREATEST(FLOOR(m.qty) - COALESCE(c.own_generated, 0), 0)) quota FROM sn_prd_mo m LEFT JOIN sn_line_count c ON c.bill_no = m.bill_no AND c.seq = m.seq
GROUP BY m.bill_no ORDER BY MAX(m.modify_time) IS NULL, MAX(m.modify_time) DESC, m.bill_no DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT m.org_code, MAX(m.org_name) org_name, m.dept_code, MAX(m.dept_name) dept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.bill_no) bills, COUNT(*) line_count, MAX(m.modify_time) modify_time FROM sn_prd_mo m WHERE m.dept_code <> '' GROUP BY m.org_code, m.dept_code ORDER BY m.org_code, m.dept_code
SELECT MAX(m.synced_at) ts, COUNT(DISTINCT m.bill_no) bills, COUNT(*) row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.customer_code = '' THEN m.bill_no END) empty_customer FROM sn_prd_mo m WHERE 1=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sn_prd_mo m LEFT JOIN sn_line_attach a ON a.bill_no = m.bill_no AND a.seq = m.seq WHERE m.attach_no = '' AND (a.bill_no IS NULL OR a.material_code <> m.material_code)
